primitives.name: QB Stack Correlation
primitives.verbatim_quote: (FD sample: every 2022 winner listed used a QB-centric primary stack: QB/TE, QB/WR/WR, or QB/RB/WR/TE.) - Since Week 1 2020, only **3** FD winning lineups used **fewer than 4 correlated players**.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'Q': 'Quarterback position', 'C': 'Correlated pass-catcher (WR/TE)', 'N_corr': 'Number of correlated players in lineup'}
primitives.assumptions: QB-centric stacks dominate due to strong QB-WR correlation and variance increase in top-heavy contests.
primitives.breakdown_regime: N_corr < 4 leads to suboptimal variance and win probability in GPPs.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to variance maximization in stochastic portfolio selection where Q and C form a correlated pair.
layer2.telemetry: Percentage of top-10 FD lineups using QB/C combinations.

primitives.name: Bring-Back Correlation
primitives.verbatim_quote: A bring-back (opposing player from the same game) appears in the overwhelming majority of winners.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'B': 'Bring-back player', 'T': "Opposing team's pass-catcher", 'V_B': 'Variance contribution of bring-back'}
primitives.assumptions: Bring-backs increase joint upside while reducing risk of total failure in GPPs.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Absence of bring-back in >95% of top lineups indicates low ROI.

layer2.mapping: Kernel of variance reduction through inter-team correlation in asymmetric contests.
layer2.telemetry: Frequency of bring-back usage in top FD winners since 2020.

primitives.name: FLEX Position Default
primitives.verbatim_quote: FLEX position in winners (HARD DATA) | Finding | Source | |---|---| | **59% of last 59 FD Sunday Million winners (35/59) rostered 3 RBs** (i.e., RB in FLEX) | 4for
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'F': 'Flex position', 'RB_F': 'Running back in FLEX', 'P_win': 'Probability of winning with RB_F'}
primitives.assumptions: RB in FLEX is statistically optimal due to higher frequency in winning lineups.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Use of TE-in-FLEX is conditional on salary structure, not correlation.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to salary-structure optimization where RB_F maximizes expected return per dollar spent.
layer2.telemetry: Proportion of winning lineups with 3 RBs in FLEX.
